audit.notes: The new chapter blocks comprehensively cover all scientific content present in the old draft. Specifically: Block 1 covers the computational advantage debate and lack of consensus; Block 2 details the simulation-reality gap, fabrication errors, and vaccination strategies; Block 3 addresses training paradigms, gradient breaks, and nonlinearity issues; Block 4 discusses architectural trade-offs (specialization vs. flexibility) and multi-wavelength/multifunctional approaches; Block 5 covers hardware bottlenecks including environmental sensitivity, coherence requirements, and CMOS integration; Block 6 presents minimalist approaches, passive encoding roles, and spatial multiplexing limits. No scientifically useful mechanisms, comparisons, or boundary conditions from the old draft are missing.
